text:
carla_peopleops: Quick heads-up — before we publish the final Q2 review calendar I want to run a 30-min calibration dry-run to validate the rubric and pre-read packet. Two asks: (1) can leads attend a dry-run on Thu evening PST or Fri morning CET? (2) do managers want a redacted pre-read version? Reply with availability. :spiral_calendar:

olivia_hr: I'm fine with Thu 18:30 PST. Redacted pre-read is preferred — it helps reduce anchor bias. We'll provide both redacted and full versions for leads only.

tariq_manager: Thu 18:30 PST works for me. Quick Q: what's in the pre-read packet?

calib-lead-ryan: Pre-read will include: 1) anonymized summary of outcomes + 1-line rationale, 2) manager suggested calibration bucket, 3) short evidence links (redacted). We'll also attach a one-page "scoring cheat sheet" (rubric v4).

carla_peopleops: Excellent. Timeline tweaks I propose: self-assessments due 2026-05-02 23:59 UTC, pre-read packet to leads by 2026-05-04 12:00 UTC (redacted), calibration dry-run Thu 2026-05-06 18:30 PST, formal calibrations start Mon 2026-05-10. If any timezone conflicts DM me.

olivia_hr: Also add: for APAC managers, we will offer one late slot (Tue 03:00 UTC) for live calibration or they can submit async votes by the close time. Proxy rules: proxy must be a peer manager and must include a short proxy rationale in the sheet.

tariq_manager: Noted. Can we have an optional one-paragraph manager summary template? My team finds it helps with consistency across eng.

calib-lead-ryan: Yup — template: "Top 3 contributions (1-2 metrics each); Collaboration highlights (who/what); Suggested calibration placement and 1-line justification." Keep to ~150 words. I'll paste it in the doc.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: managers on the "early submit" list have their draft comments due in 48 hours. Check calendar for invites.

carla_peopleops: Final ask: leads, please confirm dry-run attendance by EOD today. I'll post the dry-run invite and the redacted pre-read link once you confirm. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
